entries.sql: UPDATE target t SET n=t.n+s.delta,cold='new' FROM source s WHERE t.id=s.id RETURNING t.n,s.delta,(SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY x.delta) FROM source x WHERE x.id=s.id) AS d
UPDATE target t SET n=t.n+s.delta,cold='new' FROM source s WHERE t.id=s.id RETURNING t.n,s.delta,(SELECT max(x.delta) FROM source x WHERE x.id=s.id) AS d
DELETE FROM target t USING source s WHERE t.id=s.id RETURNING t.n,s.delta,(SELECT x.delta FROM source x WHERE x.id=s.id) AS d
UPDATE target t SET n=t.n+s.delta,cold='new' FROM source s WHERE t.id=s.id RETURNING t.n,s.delta,(SELECT s.delta) AS d
UPDATE target t SET n=t.n+s.delta,cold='new' FROM source s WHERE t.id=s.id RETURNING t.n,s.delta,(SELECT max(x.delta) FROM source x WHERE x.delta<=t.n) AS d
UPDATE target t SET n=t.n+s.delta,cold='new' FROM source s WHERE t.id=s.id RETURNING t.n,s.delta,CASE WHEN s.delta>0 THEN t.n ELSE (SELECT 1/(x.delta-x.delta) FROM source x WHERE x.id=s.id) END AS d
UPDATE target t SET n=t.n+s.delta,cold='new' FROM source s WHERE t.id=s.id RETURNING t.n,s.delta,(SELECT x.delta FROM source x WHERE x.id='absent') AS d
UPDATE target t SET n=t.n+s.delta,cold='new' FROM (SELECT id,delta FROM source) s WHERE t.id=s.id RETURNING t.n,s.delta,(SELECT s.delta) AS d
WITH src AS (SELECT id,delta FROM source) UPDATE target t SET n=t.n+s.delta,cold='new' FROM src s WHERE t.id=s.id RETURNING t.n,s.delta,(SELECT s.delta) AS d
